headline: 《侠探杰克》双榜领跑 影视热度齐爆
headlineEn: Jack Reacher tops both movie and TV charts
summary: 今日零新片，本周8部新片。电影《最后的曙光》领跑热榜，剧集《绿灯军团》强势霸屏，《侠探杰克》再现影视双线热度。
summaryEn: No new movies today, 8 this week. Movie 'Last Light' leads, series 'Green Lantern Corps' surges, and 'Reacher' dominates across both screens.

industryHighlights.text: 今日零新片上映，本周共有8部新片入市
industryHighlights.en: No movies released today; 8 new movies hit theaters this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《侠探杰克》同时登上电影与剧集热榜，IP跨媒介效应显著
industryHighlights.en: 'Reacher' trends on both movie and TV charts, showing strong cross-media IP appeal.

industryHighlights.text: 《绿灯军团》跻身本周电影和剧集双榜，关注度跨越类型
industryHighlights.en: 'Green Lantern Corps' appears on both weekly movie and TV lists, drawing cross-genre attention.

industryHighlights.text: 《Ted Lasso》剧集热度持续走高，依然是流媒体话题焦点
industryHighlights.en: 'Ted Lasso' remains a major streaming talking point with sustained heat.

industryHighlights.text: 近期暂无值得关注的新档期安排
industryHighlights.en: No notable upcoming releases are on the horizon.
